senses.en: done or given before something happens
senses.pattern: advance notice / advance warning / advance booking / advance tickets
senses.example: [[Advance]] booking is required for all guided tours of the palace, especially during the summer holidays.
senses.example_zh: 參加皇宮的所有導覽行程都必須事先預約，暑假期間尤其如此。

senses.en: to put forward an idea or theory for discussion
senses.pattern: advance a theory / advance an argument / advance a proposal
senses.example: The professor [[advanced]] a new theory to explain why the ancient city was suddenly abandoned.
senses.example_zh: 教授提出了一個新理論，來解釋這座古城為何突然遭到遺棄。

senses.en: with something as a background, for contrast
senses.pattern: against the sky / against a white background / stand out against sth
senses.example: The tall pine trees looked almost black [[against]] the orange evening sky.
senses.example_zh: 高大的松樹襯著橘紅色的傍晚天空，看起來幾乎是黑色的。

senses.en: touching, pressing on, or leaning on something
senses.pattern: lean against the wall / press sth against sth / rest against sth
senses.example: Tired after the long hike, he sat down and rested his back [[against]] a large rock.
senses.example_zh: 長途健行後很累，他坐下來，背倚著一塊大石頭休息。

senses.en: in order to protect from or prevent something
senses.pattern: protection against sth / guard against sth / a vaccine against flu / insure sth against fire
senses.example: Hikers are advised to wear long sleeves as protection [[against]] insect bites in the forest.
senses.example_zh: 建議登山客穿長袖，以預防森林裡的蚊蟲叮咬。

gsat.sentence: You might speed up healing time by gently pressing a warm washcloth [[against]] your eyelid for 10 minutes, 3 or 4 times a day.
Nature provides other forms of protection [[against]] environmental dangers.

senses.en: to speak to someone to ask for something
senses.pattern: approach sb about sth / approach sb for help / approach a bank for a loan
senses.example: Several students [[approached]] the principal about starting a recycling club on campus.
senses.example_zh: 幾位學生找校長商量在校園成立資源回收社的事。

senses.en: to begin dealing with a task in a particular way
senses.pattern: approach a problem / approach a task / approach the issue differently
senses.example: A good scientist [[approaches]] every problem with patience and an open mind.
senses.example_zh: 優秀的科學家會以耐心和開放的心態著手處理每一個問題。

senses.en: a large number of people or things
senses.pattern: an army of volunteers / an army of ants / an army of fans
senses.example: After the flood, an [[army]] of volunteers arrived with shovels to help residents clean their homes.
senses.example_zh: 水災過後，大批志工帶著鏟子前來，幫助居民清理家園。
senses.note: 常用 an army of＋複數名詞

senses.en: ordinary; not special or especially good
senses.pattern: the average person / an average student / of average ability / just average
senses.example: The food at the new restaurant was only [[average]], but the service was warm and friendly.
senses.example_zh: 那家新餐廳的菜色很普通，但服務親切又友善。

senses.en: to be or do a certain amount as an average
senses.pattern: average eight hours a day / average 20 points a game / average 50 km an hour
senses.example: Teenagers in the survey [[averaged]] only six hours of sleep on school nights.
senses.example_zh: 調查中的青少年在上學日的晚上平均只睡六小時。
senses.note: 後面直接接數量，不加介系詞

gsat.sentence: For the [[average]] person, however, water remains a very good option for keeping hydrated—if you know how to drink it.

senses.en: to improve something or make it better
senses.pattern: better the lives of / better oneself / better working conditions
senses.example: The charity works to [[better]] the lives of children growing up in remote mountain villages.
senses.example_zh: 這個慈善機構致力於改善偏遠山村孩童的生活。

senses.en: to do better than a previous result
senses.pattern: better a record / better one's score / cannot be bettered
senses.example: The young swimmer hopes to [[better]] her own national record at next month's championships.
senses.example_zh: 這位年輕泳將希望在下個月的錦標賽中超越自己保持的全國紀錄。

senses.en: a small room where a prisoner is kept
senses.pattern: a prison cell / a police cell / be locked in a cell
senses.example: The thief spent the night in a police [[cell]] before appearing in court the next morning.
senses.example_zh: 那名小偷在警局的牢房裡過了一夜，隔天早上才出庭。

senses.en: a device that produces electricity from chemicals or sunlight
senses.pattern: a solar cell / a fuel cell / a battery cell
senses.example: Solar [[cells]] on the roof turn sunlight into enough electricity to power the whole house.
senses.example_zh: 屋頂上的太陽能電池把陽光轉換成足以供應整棟房子的電力。

senses.en: (of a disaster or disease) to cause someone's death
senses.pattern: claim lives / claim the life of / claim many victims
senses.example: The disease [[claimed]] the lives of many farm animals before a vaccine was finally developed.
senses.example_zh: 在疫苗終於研發出來之前，這種疾病奪走了許多農場動物的性命。

senses.en: to ask for something you have a right to
senses.pattern: claim a refund / claim compensation / claim lost luggage / claim a prize
senses.example: Passengers whose flights are canceled can [[claim]] a full refund within thirty days.
senses.example_zh: 班機遭取消的旅客可在三十天內申請全額退款。
senses.note: 名詞：an insurance claim＝保險理賠申請

gsat.sentence: The lonely “wind phone” serves to connect family members to their departed loved ones who died in the tsunami that [[claimed]] 18,000 lives.
When he was nine, the country’s civil war [[claimed]] the life of his mother and left him homeless.

senses.en: kindness and care for other people's feelings
senses.pattern: show consideration for others / out of consideration for / lack of consideration
senses.example: Please show some [[consideration]] for your neighbors and turn the music down after ten.
senses.example_zh: 請體諒一下鄰居，十點以後把音樂關小聲。

senses.en: a fact to think about when deciding something
senses.pattern: an important consideration / financial considerations / safety considerations
senses.example: For most families choosing a school, distance from home is an important [[consideration]].
senses.example_zh: 對大多數選學校的家庭而言，離家遠近是重要的考量因素。

gsat.sentence: Out of courtesy and [[consideration]], I always write a thank-you note when someone sends me a gift.

senses.en: cells or bacteria grown for scientific study
senses.pattern: a cell culture / a culture of bacteria / tissue culture / grow in culture
senses.example: The researchers grew a [[culture]] of bacteria in the lab to test the new medicine.
senses.example_zh: 研究人員在實驗室裡做了細菌培養，用來測試這種新藥。
senses.note: 也可作動詞：培養（細菌、細胞）

senses.en: to refuse to give or allow someone something
senses.pattern: deny sb access to / be denied entry / deny sb the right to / deny a request
senses.example: The hospital was accused of [[denying]] poor patients the treatment they urgently needed.
senses.example_zh: 這家醫院被指控拒絕給予貧困病患迫切需要的治療。
senses.note: deny + 人 + 物；被動 be denied sth

senses.en: (deny yourself) to not let yourself have something
senses.pattern: deny oneself sth / deny oneself nothing / deny oneself the pleasure of
senses.example: To save money for college, he [[denied]] himself even small pleasures like snacks and movies.
senses.example_zh: 為了存大學學費，他克制自己，連零食、電影這類小小的享受都不碰。

senses.en: a tax paid on goods bought or brought into a country
senses.pattern: customs duty / import duty / pay duty on / duty-free goods
senses.example: Travelers must pay [[duty]] on any cameras or phones worth more than the legal limit.
senses.example_zh: 旅客攜帶的相機或手機若價值超過法定限額，就必須繳納關稅。

senses.en: a state of not working or functioning properly
senses.pattern: heart failure / engine failure / power failure / kidney failure
senses.example: A sudden power [[failure]] left the whole hospital in darkness until the backup generator started.
senses.example_zh: 突如其來的電力故障讓整間醫院陷入黑暗，直到備用發電機啟動為止。

senses.en: the fact of not doing something expected or required
senses.pattern: failure to do / failure to pay / failure to comply with
senses.example: [[Failure]] to wear a helmet while riding a scooter can result in a heavy fine.
senses.example_zh: 騎機車未戴安全帽，可能會被處以高額罰款。

senses.en: to decide or set a date, time, or price
senses.pattern: fix a date / fix a time / fix a price / at a fixed price
senses.example: The two schools have not yet [[fixed]] a date for the friendly basketball game.
senses.example_zh: 兩校尚未確定籃球友誼賽的日期。

senses.en: to prepare a meal or a drink
senses.pattern: fix dinner / fix sb a drink / fix a sandwich
senses.example: Dad offered to [[fix]] us some sandwiches before we left for the long hike.
senses.example_zh: 爸爸提議在我們出發去長途健行前，幫我們準備一些三明治。

senses.en: to direct your eyes or attention steadily at something
senses.pattern: fix one's eyes on / fix one's gaze on / fix one's attention on
senses.example: The little boy [[fixed]] his eyes on the magician's hands, trying to discover the trick.
senses.example_zh: 小男孩把目光集中在魔術師的手上，想找出其中的訣竅。

gsat.sentence: Another child said dieting meant “you [[fix]] food but you don’t eat it.”
It is more polite to [[fix]] your eyes on him/her as long as you can.

senses.zh: 有影響力的人或事物；勢力
senses.en: a person or thing that has great influence
senses.pattern: a driving force / a powerful force / a force for good
senses.example: Social media has become a powerful [[force]] in shaping what young people buy and wear.
senses.example_zh: 社群媒體已成為一股強大的勢力，影響著年輕人的購買與穿著。

senses.en: an organized group of soldiers or police
senses.pattern: the armed forces / the police force / security forces
senses.example: Peacekeeping [[forces]] were sent to the border to protect villagers fleeing the fighting.
senses.example_zh: 維和部隊被派往邊境，保護逃離戰火的村民。

gsat.sentence: Trade is certainly a main driving [[force]] for globalization.
The [[forces]] that are crushing individual lives and futures are also destroying the prospects for an entire region.

senses.en: to send a letter or message on to someone
senses.pattern: forward an email to sb / forward a message / forward mail to a new address
senses.example: Could you [[forward]] the teacher's email to me? I seem to have deleted it by mistake.
senses.example_zh: 你可以把老師的電子郵件轉寄給我嗎？我好像不小心把它刪掉了。

senses.en: an attacking player in a team sport
senses.pattern: play forward / a center forward / a star forward
senses.example: The team's tallest [[forward]] scored twice in the last five minutes of the match.
senses.example_zh: 該隊最高的前鋒在比賽最後五分鐘內兩度得分。

gsat.sentence: Your address was [[forwarded]] to us by Why Bother Magazine.

senses.en: to help something progress or succeed
senses.pattern: further one's career / further the cause of / further one's interests
senses.example: The scholarship was created to [[further]] the study of marine life in the Pacific region.
senses.example_zh: 這項獎學金的設立，是為了促進太平洋地區海洋生物的研究。
senses.note: 此義為及物動詞，後面直接接受詞

senses.en: to match or show something very closely
senses.pattern: mirror the trend / mirror reality / closely mirror sth / be mirrored in sth
senses.example: The mood of the novel [[mirrors]] the author's own lonely childhood in a small mining town.
senses.example_zh: 這部小說的氛圍反映了作者在礦業小鎮度過的孤單童年。

senses.en: a large keyboard instrument with pipes
senses.pattern: play the organ / a church organ / organ music
senses.example: Every Sunday morning, the sound of the [[organ]] fills the small stone church by the river.
senses.example_zh: 每個星期天早上，管風琴的樂聲迴盪在河邊那座小石造教堂裡。

senses.en: an official organization that is part of a larger body
senses.pattern: an organ of government / state organs / the official organ of
senses.example: Courts are important [[organs]] of the state, and they must stay independent to protect citizens' rights.
senses.example_zh: 法院是國家的重要機關，必須保持獨立才能保障人民的權利。

senses.en: unfairly supporting one person or side over another
senses.pattern: be partial to one side / be partial toward the home team / be partial in one's judgment
senses.example: Fans complained that the referee was [[partial]] toward the home team throughout the final match.
senses.example_zh: 球迷抱怨裁判在整場決賽中都偏袒主隊。

senses.en: be partial to: liking something very much
senses.pattern: be partial to sweets / be partial to spicy food / be very partial to
senses.example: My aunt is especially [[partial]] to mango ice cream and orders it every time we eat out.
senses.example_zh: 我阿姨特別偏愛芒果冰淇淋，每次外出用餐都會點。
senses.note: 只作補語：be partial to＋名詞

senses.en: very careful about what one chooses; hard to please
senses.pattern: be particular about food / be very particular about sth / particular about what one wears
senses.example: The hotel's chefs are very [[particular]] about where their vegetables come from and visit the farms themselves.
senses.example_zh: 這家飯店的主廚對蔬菜的來源非常講究，還會親自到農場查看。

senses.en: the details or facts about something, especially written ones
senses.pattern: the particulars of the case / give full particulars / take down sb's particulars
senses.example: The police officer wrote down the [[particulars]] of the accident before letting both drivers go.
senses.example_zh: 警察記下這起事故的詳情後，才讓兩位駕駛離開。

senses.en: the person you are married to or live with
senses.pattern: a life partner / a long-term partner / husbands, wives, or partners
senses.example: Employees may bring their husbands, wives, or [[partners]] to the company's year-end dinner.
senses.example_zh: 員工可以帶丈夫、妻子或伴侶參加公司的尾牙。

senses.en: one of the owners of a business
senses.pattern: a business partner / a senior partner / a partner in a law firm
senses.example: After ten years at the law firm, she was finally made a [[partner]] and shared its profits.
senses.example_zh: 在那家法律事務所工作十年後，她終於成為合夥人，並分享利潤。

senses.en: a written contract of insurance
senses.pattern: an insurance policy / take out a policy / renew a policy
senses.example: Read your travel insurance [[policy]] carefully to find out whether it covers lost luggage.
senses.example_zh: 請仔細閱讀你的旅遊保險單，看看行李遺失是否在理賠範圍內。

senses.en: an opinion or attitude about a particular subject
senses.pattern: take a position on / make your position clear / the official position
senses.example: The principal made her [[position]] on cell phones clear: they must stay off during class.
senses.example_zh: 校長清楚表明她對手機的立場：上課時一律關機。

senses.en: the situation that someone is in
senses.pattern: be in a position to do / in a difficult position / put sb in an awkward position
senses.example: Having just lost his job, Mark was in no [[position]] to lend money to anyone.
senses.example_zh: 馬克剛失業，以他的處境根本無法借錢給任何人。
senses.note: be in no position to V＝無法…

gsat.sentence: Since I do not fully understand your proposal, I am not in the [[position]] to make any comment on it.

senses.en: a group of lions living together
senses.pattern: a pride of lions / the leader of the pride
senses.example: From the jeep we watched a [[pride]] of lions resting in the shade of a large tree.
senses.example_zh: 我們從吉普車上看著一個獅群在大樹的樹蔭下休息。

senses.en: to be proud of a quality or skill
senses.pattern: pride oneself on / pride itself on quality
senses.example: The restaurant [[prides]] itself on using only vegetables grown by local farmers.
senses.example_zh: 這家餐廳以只使用在地農夫栽種的蔬菜自豪。
senses.note: 須接反身代名詞再加 on

senses.en: someone or something that results from a process or situation
senses.pattern: a product of / the product of one's environment / a product of hard work / a product of its time
senses.example: Her calm confidence on stage is the [[product]] of years of daily practice.
senses.example_zh: 她在台上的沉著自信，是多年每日練習的產物。

senses.en: the number you get by multiplying numbers together
senses.pattern: the product of 4 and 6 / find the product / the product of two numbers
senses.example: The teacher asked us to find the [[product]] of the three numbers without a calculator.
senses.example_zh: 老師要我們不用計算機，求出那三個數的乘積。

senses.en: the small black circle in the center of the eye
senses.pattern: dilated pupils / the pupil of the eye / pupils widen / pupils shrink
senses.example: The eye doctor put in special drops to make my [[pupils]] larger before the examination.
senses.example_zh: 眼科醫師在檢查前幫我點了特殊的藥水，讓瞳孔放大。

senses.en: being the cause of something, especially something bad
senses.pattern: be responsible for / be largely responsible for / be partly responsible for
senses.example: Scientists believe that a tiny insect is [[responsible]] for the sudden death of thousands of pine trees.
senses.example_zh: 科學家認為，一種小昆蟲是造成數千棵松樹突然死亡的原因。

gsat.sentence: This substance, according to health scientists, is [[responsible]] for some serious lung diseases.
Their simple design is [[responsible]] for many foot injuries.

senses.en: needing to be kept secret or handled carefully
senses.pattern: sensitive information / sensitive data / a sensitive issue
senses.example: Never send [[sensitive]] information such as passwords or bank details over a public wireless network.
senses.example_zh: 切勿透過公共無線網路傳送密碼或銀行資料等機密資訊。

senses.en: understanding and caring about other people's feelings
senses.pattern: be sensitive to sb's needs / a sensitive listener / caring and sensitive
senses.example: A good nurse is [[sensitive]] to patients' fears and takes time to explain each treatment.
senses.example_zh: 好的護理師會體貼病人的恐懼，並花時間說明每一項治療。

gsat.sentence: Fostering empathy…By seeing an animal up close, the public could be encouraged to be more [[sensitive]] and compassionate to a species that is facing extinction in the wild.

senses.en: a liquid in which something has been dissolved
senses.pattern: a salt solution / a sugar solution / a weak solution / a solution of sth in water
senses.example: Hummingbirds can be fed with a [[solution]] made by dissolving sugar in warm water.
senses.example_zh: 蜂鳥可以用糖溶於溫水製成的溶液來餵食。

senses.en: to drive faster than the legal limit
senses.pattern: be caught speeding / be fined for speeding / a speeding ticket
senses.example: The driver was stopped by the police because he had been [[speeding]] in a school zone.
senses.example_zh: 那名駕駛因為在學校附近的路段超速行駛而被警察攔下。

senses.en: to make something happen more quickly
senses.pattern: speed recovery / speed the process / speed up production / speed things up
senses.example: Doctors say that a balanced diet and enough rest can [[speed]] recovery after surgery.
senses.example_zh: 醫生說，均衡飲食與充足休息能加快手術後的復原。
senses.note: 過去式、過去分詞：sped 或 speeded

gsat.sentence: For example, an injured runner might end up cycling and swimming instead of running. Their consensus, however, is that unless the injury involves something as serious as a broken bone or a ripped muscle, moderate exercise can actually [[speed]] healing.
You might [[speed]] up healing time by gently pressing a warm washcloth against your eyelid for 10 minutes, 3 or 4 times a day.

senses.en: to say or write something formally and clearly
senses.pattern: state that / state clearly / as stated above
senses.example: In her letter, the scientist [[stated]] that the experiment had been repeated five times with the same results.
senses.example_zh: 這位科學家在信中聲明，該實驗已重複五次，結果都相同。

senses.en: a country or its government
senses.pattern: a member state / heads of state / be run by the state
senses.example: In many countries, basic education is paid for by the [[state]] rather than by parents.
senses.example_zh: 在許多國家，基礎教育的費用是由國家而非家長負擔。

gsat.sentence: Owner Joseph Tang says he knew the idea would work well in this unique district: “Each store is one of a kind in Wonder Village,” he [[states]].
The Russian [[state]] played a significant role in the spread of alcohol consumption in the country.

senses.en: to go somewhere quickly and angrily
senses.pattern: storm out of the room / storm off / storm into the office
senses.example: After arguing with his sister, Tom [[stormed]] out of the room and slammed the door.
senses.example_zh: 和妹妹吵架後，湯姆氣沖沖地走出房間，用力甩上門。
senses.note: 後接 out、off、into 等表方向

senses.en: to attack a place suddenly with force
senses.pattern: storm a castle / storm the building / storm the beach
senses.example: In the film, soldiers [[storm]] the castle at dawn and rescue the captured villagers.
senses.example_zh: 電影中，士兵在黎明時猛攻城堡，救出被俘的村民。

gsat.sentence: They [[stormed]] away and never played on the street again.

senses.en: a person in a place they do not know
senses.pattern: a stranger in town / be a stranger here / a stranger to the city
senses.example: Sorry, I can't tell you where the post office is; I'm a [[stranger]] here myself.
senses.example_zh: 抱歉，我沒辦法告訴你郵局在哪裡，我自己也是外地人。

senses.en: someone with no experience of something
senses.pattern: be no stranger to / be a stranger to / a complete stranger to
senses.example: Having grown up in a fishing village, Amy is no [[stranger]] to hard work and early mornings.
senses.example_zh: 艾咪在漁村長大，對辛苦的工作和早起並不陌生。
senses.note: 常用 be no stranger to 對…並不陌生

senses.en: to fill something tightly, or push something into a space
senses.pattern: stuff A with B / stuff sth into a bag / be stuffed with sth / a stuffed toy
senses.example: He [[stuffed]] his dirty clothes into a backpack and ran to catch the last bus home.
senses.example_zh: 他把髒衣服塞進背包，然後跑去趕最後一班回家的公車。
senses.note: I'm stuffed. 表示「我吃撐了」

gsat.sentence: According to the legend, notes of secret plans for a revolution to overthrow the Mongols were hidden in mooncakes that would ordinarily have been [[stuffed]] with sweet bean paste.

senses.en: to take a job or position after someone else
senses.pattern: succeed someone as chairman / be succeeded by / succeed one's father
senses.example: Nobody knows who will [[succeed]] the conductor when she leaves the orchestra at the end of the season.
senses.example_zh: 沒有人知道指揮在樂季結束離開樂團後，將由誰接替她。

senses.en: to gain a title or position after someone dies
senses.pattern: succeed to the throne / succeed to the title / succeed to the crown
senses.example: The young prince [[succeeded]] to the throne at the age of nine after his father's death.
senses.example_zh: 父親去世後，年幼的王子在九歲時繼承王位。

senses.en: to provide the money someone needs to live
senses.pattern: support a family / support oneself / support one's children / support aging parents
senses.example: After her father fell ill, she took a second job to [[support]] her younger brothers.
senses.example_zh: 父親生病後，她多兼了一份工作來扶養弟弟們。

senses.en: to help show that something is true
senses.pattern: support a claim / support a theory / evidence to support / be supported by data
senses.example: The results of the new experiment [[support]] the theory that the planet once had water.
senses.example_zh: 這項新實驗的結果佐證了該行星曾經有水的理論。

gsat.sentence: Although Jeffery had to keep two part-time jobs to [[support]] his family, he never neglected his studies. In fact, he graduated with honors.
The claim that eating chocolate can prevent heart disease is disputable because there is not enough scientific evidence to [[support]] it.

senses.en: a job that needs special skill, especially with hands
senses.pattern: learn a trade / a carpenter by trade / the tourist trade / the tools of the trade
senses.example: At sixteen, he left school to learn the carpenter's [[trade]] from his uncle.
senses.example_zh: 他十六歲離開學校，向叔叔學木匠這門手藝。

senses.en: to exchange one thing for another
senses.pattern: trade A for B / trade places / trade seats / trade stories
senses.example: During lunch, Amy [[traded]] her apple for half of her classmate's chocolate cake.
senses.example_zh: 午餐時，艾咪用她的蘋果交換了同學的半塊巧克力蛋糕。

senses.en: to disturb a plan, balance, or normal situation
senses.pattern: upset the balance / upset one's plans / upset one's routine
senses.example: The sudden rain [[upset]] our plans for a barbecue by the lake.
senses.example_zh: 突如其來的雨打亂了我們在湖邊烤肉的計畫。

senses.en: a surprising result in which the favorite loses
senses.pattern: a major upset / pull off an upset / the biggest upset of the season
senses.example: In the biggest [[upset]] of the tournament, the unknown school team beat last year's champions.
senses.example_zh: 這次錦標賽爆出最大冷門：沒沒無聞的校隊擊敗了去年的冠軍。

gsat.sentence: Sea life can get sucked into desalination plants, killing small ocean creatures like baby fish and plankton, [[upsetting]] the food chain.

senses.en: very excited or enthusiastic; out of control
senses.pattern: go wild / wild cheers / be wild about / wild with joy
senses.example: The crowd went [[wild]] when the home team scored in the last second of the game.
senses.example_zh: 主隊在比賽最後一秒得分時，全場觀眾陷入瘋狂。

senses.en: not based on careful thought or facts
senses.pattern: a wild guess / wild rumors / wild accusations / a wild idea
senses.example: I had no idea how old the bridge was, so I just made a [[wild]] guess.
senses.example_zh: 我完全不知道這座橋有多古老，所以只是胡亂猜了一下。

senses.en: a natural environment far from people
senses.pattern: in the wild / return to the wild / release sth into the wild
senses.example: Pandas raised by humans often find it hard to survive after being released into the [[wild]].
senses.example_zh: 由人類飼養長大的貓熊被放回野外後，往往難以存活。
senses.note: 常用 in the wild；the wilds 指偏遠地區

gsat.sentence: The audience went [[wild]].
To me, a zoo can be a good place for endangered species which have difficulty finding suitable mates in the [[wild]].

quiz.stem: A fair judge should never be ______ to either side in a case; every decision must be based only on the evidence presented in court.
quiz.explain_zh: partial＝偏袒的。公正的法官不應偏袒任何一方，判決只能依據證據。

quiz.stem: When Principal Wang retires next summer, Ms. Lin, who has taught here for twenty years, will ______ him as head of the school.
quiz.explain_zh: succeed＝繼任、接替。王校長退休後，將由林老師接替他擔任校長。

quiz.stem: Health officials are still trying to find out which dish was ______ for making more than fifty wedding guests sick.
quiz.explain_zh: responsible＝是…的原因。衛生官員仍在追查是哪道菜造成五十多位賓客身體不適。

quiz.stem: In the lab class, we were told to soak the onion skin in a weak salt ______ for five minutes before placing it under the microscope.
quiz.explain_zh: solution＝溶液。實驗課要先把洋蔥表皮泡在稀食鹽溶液中五分鐘。

quiz.stem: The heat wave that swept across the continent last summer ______ thousands of lives, mostly those of elderly people living alone.
quiz.explain_zh: claim＝奪走（性命）。去年夏天的熱浪奪走數千條人命。

quiz.stem: Mr. Lin is so ______ about cleanliness that he wipes his desk three times a day and never lets anyone borrow his pen.
quiz.explain_zh: particular＝講究的。林先生很重視清潔，一天擦三次桌子，筆也不外借。

quiz.stem: The airline gave passengers no ______ notice of the cancellation, so hundreds of travelers were left waiting at the airport overnight.
quiz.explain_zh: advance＝事先的。航空公司未事先通知航班取消，數百名旅客只好在機場過夜。

quiz.stem: In dim light, the ______ of our eyes grow larger so that more light can enter and help us see more clearly.
quiz.explain_zh: pupil＝瞳孔。光線昏暗時瞳孔會放大，讓更多光線進入眼睛。

quiz.stem: Several visitors were ______ entry to the laboratory because they had not completed the required safety training.
quiz.explain_zh: deny＝拒絕給予、不准。訪客未完成安全訓練，因此不准進入實驗室。

quiz.stem: Scientists have found that the number of birds on the island closely ______ changes in the local climate, rising in warm years and falling in cold ones.
quiz.explain_zh: mirror＝反映、與…極為相似。島上鳥類的數量緊跟著當地氣候的變化而增減。
